## About [Jobsity](https://www.jobsity.com/)💡
Jobsity is a New York–based staffing company with 10+ years of experience, working with clients across the US, Canada, and Europe. We connect top-tier LATAM talent—only the top 3%—with long-term international opportunities and have successfully placed over 400 professionals across 15+ countries. As part of our recruitment process, we focus on finding the right role based on what matters most to you.

## Requirements

𝗪̳𝗵̳𝗮̳𝘁̳ ̳𝗱̳𝗼̳ ̳𝘆̳𝗼̳𝘂̳ ̳𝗻̳𝗲̳𝗲̳𝗱̳ ̳𝘁̳𝗼̳ ̳𝗮̳𝗽̳𝗽̳𝗹̳𝘆̳ ̳𝘀̳𝘂̳𝗰̳𝗰̳𝗲̳𝘀̳𝘀̳𝗳̳𝘂̳𝗹̳𝗹̳𝘆̳?🥇
🌟 A minimum of +B2 level Conversational English level
🌟 Must reside in Latin America🌎
🌟 Availability to work Italian business hours (CET/CEST), with the workday starting at 9:00 AM CET and a daily stand-up at 9:30 AM CET ⏲️ 
🌟 5+ years of hands-on backend development with Go (Golang), building production services and APIs.
🌟 3+ years of hands-on experience with Apache Kafka, including consumer groups, consumer lag, and safe schema evolution that doesn't break downstream consumers.
🌟 Experience with event sourcing and event-driven architectures, applying DDD principles.

## Modality
👨‍💻 Fully remote

## Perks that Jobsity offers!💎

🔹Yearly paid vacation.
🔹Paid local holidays.
🔹Learning budget.
🔹Financing program for home office supplies.
🔹Bonuses for referrals and more!

## Type of contract📜

This role is full-time!🕘
...working remotely🏡, with USD payment💰, long-term relationship🤝, within an international team👩‍💻 👨‍💻, and working on international client projects!🌎

## How to apply🤔
✔️ Send an email to angela.barboza@jobsity.com with your CV and LinkedIn attached

✔️ Or just send me a DM!

## How to refer a friend🤔
✔️ Refer a friend👥 sending an email with your friend's CV and LinkedIn attached
✔️ Or just send me a DM!

## Any questions or additional details needed?
Feel free to send me a message on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/angela-barboza/)💬

gh_a2bf5d8b1ac2ec634b465f35.title: Consider adding a Canada-specific student/product jobs companion resource
gh_a2bf5d8b1ac2ec634b465f35.description:
Hi Jobright team — thanks for maintaining this Product Management internship tracker.

Would you consider adding a small Canada-specific companion resource link for students who use this repo but want more Canadian student/new-grad coverage?

Suggested link:

```md
- [Hanzilla Jobs – Canadian business, product-adjacent, and student jobs](https://jobs.hanzilla.co/business/) — free daily-updated Canadian student/recent-grad board covering business, product-adjacent, analyst, finance, engineering, tech, internships/co-ops, new-grad, junior, and entry-level roles. Internship-focused page: https://jobs.hanzilla.co/internships/
```

Why it seems relevant here:

- this repo already surfaces Canada-relevant product/product-strategy roles such as Toronto/Oakville listings;
- Hanzilla is Canada-specific and aimed at university students/recent grads, so it complements a broader global/Product Management tracker rather than replacing it;
- the board is not CS-only: it includes business, finance, engineering, sciences, tech, internships/co-ops, new-grad, junior, and entry-level roles.

For trust/context, the project about/verification page is here: https://jobs.hanzilla.co/about/

No worries if external companion links are out of scope — just wanted to suggest it for Canadian students landing here from search.
